title: Good so far. Wish banana hook was sturdier.
text: Good so far. Wish banana hook was sturdier.. Very simple to assemble. There are only two screws that need to be tightened. I was surprised to find that the banana hook wasn't sturdier or tightened to the basket. All it does it just dangle there. While it can be easily knocked out, it hasn't been yet.
